title: 第3章 他是勇者第4章 任务完成
slug: 异世界开局俘虏女骑士
lines: 卡塔丽娜头皮一阵发麻，面前的男人挥舞的长剑裹挟着巨大的势能直冲自己的脖子而来。
她慌忙调转骑士枪进行格挡。
自古以来，骑兵依靠着胯下的战马具备了强大的机动力和冲击力，而像卡塔丽娜这样的大骑士，一旦开始冲锋足以堪比一辆战车。
可金无足赤，由于马背上的腾挪空间非常有限，静止状态下的骑兵几乎和靶子没有区别。
卡塔丽娜眼睁睁地看着那柄卖相朴素的长剑如同切黄油一般毫无滞涩地将她的骑士枪一分为二。
逃离王城已经半年了，这位一路走来克服了数十场截杀的强大骑士第一次闻到死亡的味道。
简直就是一场噩梦。
卡塔丽娜实在想不明白刚才还像老鼠一般怯弱的男人，怎么会在顷刻间变成一只择人而噬的猛兽。
铛！
金铁交击声响彻天空。
卡塔丽娜一身骑士板甲加上体重超过了八十公斤，此刻却像一颗扎了洞的气球一样从战马上飞了出去。
鲜红的血珠在空气中飞散，女骑士的身体在空中划出了一条直线撞在了泥泞的地面上，
她像皮球一样在地上滚了好几圈终于在撞到一颗风桃树后停了下来。
左肩的厚实铠甲被开了个巨大的口子，血液从那条裂缝里汩汩流出。
鲜红在地上曲折蔓延成了一条溪流，一截断剑斜插在这条红色的溪流上将其分成两半，像是一块银色的礁石。
齐格飞看了一眼手里只剩一半的长剑，回想起了它的鉴定信息。
圣剑【巴鲁姆克】
类别：武器
品质：唯一
勇者巴鲁姆克是一位被古龙抚养长大的人类。当他踏上旅途时，他的龙母将这把从冒险者手中抢来的长剑当做临别礼物送给了他。
这把毫无特异的长剑陪伴着巴鲁姆克走过了十年风雨，斩断了罪恶，斩碎了不公，斩杀了魔王。
旅途的最后，勇者带着伙伴们荣归故里一同建造起了风桃村，这把朴素的长剑也就世世代代留存于村庄。
效果：
1.大幅度提高持剑者各项身体素质。
2.此剑在对抗混沌阵营时会展现出真正的力量。
3.此剑对龙族有着强大的亲和力。
4.此剑对魔兽有着天然的威慑力。
警告！圣剑若是攻击秩序阵营的生灵，剑身便会折断。
备注：不是圣剑选择的人是勇者，而是勇者选择的剑是圣剑。
七天前齐格飞穿越过来的时候这把剑就挂在他的腰间。
记忆显示这把剑是十八岁成人那天，老村长作为成人礼送给他的。
为将来某一天齐格飞成为勇者拯救世界做好准备。
也就是我们常说的“村里最好的剑”。
由于卖相实在朴素齐格飞一直没去在意这把剑，直到刚刚用漫游手册鉴定了一下。
（新手大礼包坏掉了……）
他心里一阵肉痛。
content_en:
Katarina's scalp felt numb, and the sword wielded by the man in front of her came straight towards her neck with huge potential energy.
She hurriedly turned the knight's gun to block.
Since ancient times, cavalry have relied on the horses under their crotches to possess powerful maneuverability and impact, and a great knight like Catalina can be compared to a chariot once she starts charging.
But gold is not enough, because the moving space on horseback is very limited, the cavalry in a stationary state is almost indistinguishable from a target.
Katarina watched helplessly as the simple-looking long sword sliced ​​her knight's spear into two pieces as smoothly as it sliced ​​butter.
It had been half a year since he fled the royal city, and this powerful knight who had overcome dozens of interceptions along the way smelled death for the first time.
What a nightmare.
Katarina really couldn't understand how the man who was as timid as a mouse just now could turn into a beast that chooses and devours people in an instant.
clang!
The sound of gold and iron clashing filled the sky.
Katarina was wearing a knight's plate armor and weighed more than 80 kilograms. At this moment, she flew out of the horse like a balloon with a hole in it.
Bright red blood beads scattered in the air, and the female knight's body drew a straight line in the air and hit the muddy ground.
She rolled around on the ground like a ball for several times and finally stopped after hitting a peach tree.
There was a huge hole in the thick armor on his left shoulder, and blood gurgled out from the crack.
The bright red zigzag spread on the ground into a stream. A broken sword was inserted diagonally into the red stream and divided it into two halves, like a silver reef.
Siegfried glanced at the half-remaining sword in his hand and recalled its identification information.
Holy Sword [Barumk]
Category: Weapons
Quality: unique
The brave Barumk is a human who was raised by an ancient dragon. When he embarked on his journey, his dragon mother gave him the long sword snatched from the adventurers as a parting gift.
This unremarkable long sword accompanied Barumke through ten years of ups and downs, cutting off evil, injustice, and killing the devil.
At the end of the journey, the brave man returned home with his friends and built Fengtao Village together. This simple long sword has remained in the village for generations.
Effect:
1. Significantly improve the physical qualities of the sword wielder.
2. This sword will show its true power when fighting against the Chaos camp.
3. This sword has a strong affinity towards dragons.
4. This sword has a natural deterrent effect on monsters.
warn! If the holy sword attacks a creature in the order camp, the sword will break.
Note: It is not the person chosen by the Holy Sword who is the brave, but the sword chosen by the brave is the Holy Sword.
This sword was hanging on Siegfried's waist when he crossed over seven days ago.
The memory shows that this sword was given to him by the old village chief as a coming-of-age gift on the day he turned eighteen.
Prepare for Siegfried to become a hero and save the world one day in the future.
It is what we often call "the best sword in the village".
Due to its plain appearance, Siegfried never paid much attention to this sword until he just used the Hitchhiker's Manual to appraise it.
(The novice gift package is broken...)
His heart ached.
